title: WEIRD Audits? Research Trends, Linguistic and Geographical Disparities in the Algorithm Audits of Online Platforms - A Systematic Literature Review
findings: Religion is an infrequently studied attribute in algorithm audits. Out of 176 reviewed papers, only three focused on religion, indicating it is examined far less often than other attributes like gender, race, or age. The studies that did include religion considered diverse religious groups.
